title: EMA trend with stops and sizing
note: Contract 0.2: the signal says when to enter; exits, sizing and execution say how the position is managed. Entry on a 20/60 EMA cross, out on the reverse cross, a fixed 8% stop, a 10% trailing stop that starts after a 15% gain, and a time exit after 20 days without a new high. Each entry is 20% of equity, at most four held at once, filled at the next open.
